component.name: Perfect Audio Copy
component.summary: Rip audio CDs to FLAC with secure, verified extraction

description.p: Perfect Audio Copy makes bit-exact copies of audio CDs. It reads every sector until two reads agree, re-reads damaged sectors up to 82 times, corrects the drive's read offset, and checks every track against the AccurateRip database.

ul.li: Secure, burst and paranoid (test and copy) extraction
Automatic drive setup: read offset, caching and C2 error pointer tests
AccurateRip v1 and v2 verification, including other pressings
Album details and cover art from MusicBrainz, the Cover Art Archive and Discogs
FLAC with tags, embedded cover, ReplayGain, CUE sheet and a checksummed rip log
Plex-friendly folders, with a folder per disc for multi-disc sets

description.p: First version: secure ripping, AccurateRip verification, metadata, FLAC output and the desktop app.
